data.scenario: SE21 normal: private cash buyer, bill-to = sold-to, no related party
SE21 exception PASS: bill-to Ziklo Bank, Brand line already on 3030
SE21 exception FAIL: bill-to Volvo Bank, Brand line left on 3022 (the screenshot case)
data.remediation: Change revenue category on line 4 from 3022 to 3030 (related party).

data.scenario: SE21 exception FAIL: Ziklo Bank is sold-to, Brand line on 3027
data.remediation: Change revenue category on line 1 from 3027 to 3030 (related party).

data.scenario: SE21 normal: corporate fleet buyer with PO
SE21 generic FAIL: extended amount does not equal quantity × unit price
data.remediation: Correct extended amount on line 1 to 479,200.00; total then agrees with POMS.

data.scenario: NO21 normal: private buyer, not NGA, fees chargeable, matches POMS
NO21 NGA PASS: tracker says remove fees; fees removed, gross and base revised, VAT recalculated
NO21 NGA FAIL: tracker says remove fees but fee lines are still on the draft
data.remediation: Remove lines 3 and 4 (fees), set gross to revised 659,800.00, recalculate VAT, then submit.

data.scenario: NO21 NGA FAIL: NGA customer but invoice never captured in the NGA tracker
data.remediation: Capture invoice number, customer ID, model, total, gross and base price in the NGA tracker.

data.scenario: NO21 NGA HOLD: tracker submitted, NGA team response still pending
data.remediation: Wait for NGA team response (fees decision, revised gross, revised base) before processing.

data.scenario: NO21 NGA FAIL: fees removed and gross revised but VAT still calculated on the old gross
data.remediation: Recalculate VAT: 25% of 449,900.00 = 112,475.00 (draft shows 115,772.50).

data.scenario: NO21 FAIL: Workday vehicle price 459,900 vs POMS 449,900 (manual amendment needed)
data.remediation: Amend line 1 unit price to the POMS base price 449,900.00.

data.scenario: NO21 FAIL: payment recorded On Account but missing from the factoring tracker (processing delay)
data.remediation: Log PAY-NO-88213 (200,000.00 NOK) in the factoring tracker and re-apply against the invoice.

data.scenario: NO21 NGA PASS: tracker confirms fees are chargeable; fee lines retained, amounts unchanged
NO21 NGA FAIL: tracker row exists but Model Number and Base Price were not captured
data.remediation: Complete the tracker row: model_number = P4, base_price = 649,900.00.

data.scenario: PT21 normal: private cash buyer; E&Y final invoice matches on date, amount, name, PO
PT21 leasing PASS: LeasePlan, licence plate from POMS present in the line description
PT21 leasing FAIL: Arval, licence plate BH-44-LQ missing from the description
data.remediation: Append ' - Matrícula BH-44-LQ' (from POMS) to the vehicle line description.

data.scenario: PT21 leasing FAIL: Kinto, plate on invoice CJ-10-MN, POMS has CJ-01-MN
data.remediation: Correct the plate in the description to CJ-01-MN as recorded in POMS.

data.scenario: PT21 personal loan PASS: Lusitânia Crédito finances; bill-to changed to buyer so bill-to = sold-to = buyer
PT21 personal loan FAIL: bill-to still Crédito Ibérico SA instead of the buyer
data.remediation: Change Bill-To from Crédito Ibérico SA to Pedro Almeida (Bill-To = Sold-To = Buyer).

data.scenario: PT21 Banco BPI PASS: sold-to changed to Banco BPI SA so bill-to = sold-to = loan provider
PT21 Banco BPI FAIL: sold-to is still the buyer Rui Martins
data.remediation: Change Sold-To from Rui Martins to Banco BPI SA.

data.scenario: PT21 prepayment FAIL: customer VAT number blank on the draft; Salesforce holds PT509876543
data.remediation: Populate customer VAT number PT509876543 from Salesforce account 001PT00000A1B2C.

data.scenario: PT21 prepayment PASS: VAT number populated
PT21 E&Y FAIL: E&Y final invoice amount 47,900.00 excl. VAT vs Workday 45,900.00
data.remediation: E&Y error before Workday approval: mirror the E&Y invoice or request E&Y to reissue; do not approve.

data.scenario: PT21 E&Y FAIL: invoice date in Workday differs from the E&Y final invoice date
data.remediation: Update the Workday invoice date to the exact E&Y date.

data.scenario: PT21 gapless FAIL: Workday statutory number is one ahead of the E&Y number for this invoice
data.remediation: Set statutory invoice number to the E&Y number; approve strictly in E&Y sequence.

data.scenario: PT21 gapless FAIL: approved in Workday before the E&Y final invoice was received
data.remediation: Cancel approval; wait for the E&Y final invoice, then approve in sequence.

data.scenario: PT21 delivery note PASS: zero-value internal document, excluded from the daily E&Y report
PT21 credit note PASS: matches E&Y credit note; reason noted; kept in draft
DK21 normal: private cash buyer
DK21 tracker PASS: PO reference, agreed fleet price and cost-centre text all applied from SharePoint tracker
DK21 tracker FAIL: list price billed, PO reference missing, cost-centre text missing
data.remediation: Apply tracker DK-SP-002: PO OF-PO-2026-121, unit price 429,995.00, add 'CC-4410 Sales Fleet' to line 1.

data.scenario: DK21 normal: corporate buyer with accessory line
DK21 generic FAIL: VIN on the invoice does not match the POMS order
data.remediation: Correct VIN to YSMKKE2AXS9800035 from POMS order 11400005.
